precondition: unique raster line path maps carried Butt, Round and Square to homologous tiny-skia caps

variants.transform: ignore FrameItem cap and always select tiny-skia Butt
map Butt to Round and Round to Butt
map Round to Square and Square to Round

killer_witness: isolated endpoint alpha counts remain strictly Butt < Round < Square and auto bytes equal explicit Square
validity: All three mapping variants must be killed by raster output; a carrier or PDF-only failure is non-causal.
